description: A top-level reaction_systems.<k> {ref} mount (esm-spec §4.7 'Two mount forms, one mechanism'). `implemented_by` lists the bindings that mount this form; every other binding MUST refuse every fixture that uses it with `mount_form_unsupported`, at /reaction_systems/<k>. `loads` maps a fixture to the fixture it must load to: after load and emit, the two documents' `models` and `reaction_systems` blocks MUST be deep-equal (in particular the mounted reaction system carries the leaf's species, parameters and reactions, under the mount key, and no `ref`). `load_errors` maps a fixture to {code: [bindings]}: each listed binding MUST refuse the fixture at load with that code, and a binding listed under none MUST still refuse it.

notes.implemented_by: Python, TypeScript and Go do not implement this mount form yet (esm-spec §4.7). Each asserts that it refuses every mounting fixture here with mount_form_unsupported and loads the inline twins.
notes.julia: Julia's mount of this form is still the raw pre-pass esm-spec §4.7 describes: it does not close the leaf's metaparameters or merge its index_sets at the edge. None of these fixtures has either, so the two implementations must agree on all of them.
